simple.summary: מֹחַ (môach) means fat , i.e. marrow First listed occurrence: Job 21 24.

definitions.full: H4221. moach מֹחַ noun masculine marrow (Late Hebrew מוֺחַ , Arabic , Aramaic מוֺחָא , all marrow, brain ); — only construct יְשֻׁקֶּה עַצְמוֺתָיו מֹחַ Job 21:24 figurative of prosperity.
